sheet_log.title: EXTERIOR ELEVATIONS - OPTION 01
sheet_log.scale: 1" = 59'-0" (Overall West Elevation); 1" = 49'-0" (Overall South Elevation); 1" = 29'-0" (Overall East Elevation); 1" = 49'-0" (Overall North Elevation)
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A-201 shows four overall exterior elevations (North, South, East, West) for an industrial building for Crow Holdings in Bartow County, Georgia. Elevations show TI panel heights at 44'-2" (at entry) and 42'-2", finish floor at 0'-0", and truck court at -5'-0". Dock doors (RD) are visible on West and East elevations. A Glass Schedule with Types A, B, C and an Exterior Finish Schedule with codes 101-110 and 055 are shown. Building features aluminum storefront entries, pre-engineered metal canopies, pre-finished metal coping and downspouts, and painted CMU/concrete tilt-up wall panels. Issue date 01/APRIL/2021, 85% design review. Scale varies per elevation view. Grid lines A through P visible on North elevation (bottom of sheet). Exact quantities of doors, windows, and wall areas cannot be precisely counted at this image resolution.

sheet_log.title: MISC. DETAILS
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A-401 is a miscellaneous details sheet for Crow Holdings Industrial - Cass White Road, Bartow County, Georgia. Contains 13 detail drawings including dock leveler sections (future), ramp/stair details, bollard details, and fire riser/electrical panel protection. Dock leveler items are noted as FUTURE. All stair items noted to be galvanized. All pipe to be extra strong. Sheet is marked NOT ISSUED FOR CONSTRUCTION. Quantities are not directly called out - they must be counted from floor plan sheets. Bollard spacing shown as max 4'-0" OC. Job No. shown as 980174.
